# `candid mock`

Mock interviews: coding judge, AI interviewer, behavioral, design.

## Usage

```
usage: python -m candid mock [-h] <subcommand> ...
```

## Subcommands

| Subcommand | Description |
|---|---|
| `list` | List coding problems. |
| `coding` | Interactive coding session. |
| `run` | Judge a solution file non-interactively. |
| `solution` | Show reference solution + complexity. |
| `hint` | Show hints for a problem. |
| `ai` | Conversational AI interviewer (uses Gemini). |
| `behavioral` | STAR behavioral practice. |
| `design` | System design practice. |


### `candid mock list`

List coding problems.

```
usage: python -m candid mock list [-h] [--topic TOPIC] [--difficulty DIFFICULTY]
```

| Option | Description |
|---|---|
| `--topic` `TOPIC` | - |
| `--difficulty` `DIFFICULTY` | - |
